findings.title: Non-personal product eligibility reaches a personal-loan approval flow
findings.problem: Car Loan and Home Mortgage Check eligibility actions are described as entering the shared qualification flow, but the later approval/disbursement values and VB-PL reference are hard-coded to Personal Loan.
findings.fix: Either route non-personal eligibility to product-specific detail/not-available nodes and explicitly limit qualification to Personal Loan, or define product-specific conditional result, approval, reference, disbursement, and servicing branches. Add alternate-path tests for both non-personal products.
